problem_statement: One DVOTE reader reports that changing representation exposed a new question; a separate bounded field report says the same move produced no new question.
current_capabilities: compare source fingerprints without deciding which report is true
return generated comparison material to WITNESS
constraints: do not rank the reader or the second observer
do not convert a new hash into independence
preserve both source paths before interpretation
preserve: human authority over the next consequential move

reversible_levers.change: Add a temporary comparison card that places both bounded field reports side by side and asks which conditions differ before asking which interpretation wins.
reversible_levers.rollback: Remove the comparison card while retaining both source receipts and the generated comparison worksheet.

observation_channels.description: Capture both source digests, declared relation, preserved disagreement, and the next comparison question.
observation_channels.capture: content-addressed comparison worksheet plus provenance receipt
